**Step 1 - Scene:** A multi-plate lunch tray: Greek salad in a bowl, sushi rolls and a fresh spring roll on one plate, two wraps (vegetable/chicken-style filling) on a dinner plate, a slice of lemon-frosted cake on a side plate, plus small cups of dressing and soy-type sauce. The meal is judged as the items on the main plates and bowl shown.

**Step 2 - Vessel:** The main dinner plate in front is about 26 cm (area ≈ 530 cm²). Food on the side plates and bowl is treated as part of the same meal since they are all on the tray; the salad bowl is ~18 cm (≈254 cm²), the sushi/spring roll plate ~20 cm (≈314 cm²), the cake plate ~18 cm (≈254 cm²).

**Step 3 - Items:** Greek salad (tomato, cucumber, feta, olives), two sushi rolls, one fresh spring roll, two halves of a wrap with greens and filling, a cake slice with frosting, dressing cup, soy sauce cup.

**Step 4 - Area (of each plate):**
- Wraps on dinner plate: ~25% of 530 cm² ≈ 130 cm², height ~4 cm → 520 ml × 0.2 (mixed leafy filling, wrap-dominated) ≈ 100 g of wrap/filling combined; split as wrap bread ~60 g and leafy/vegetable filling ~40 g.
- Greek salad bowl: ~60% of 254 cm² ≈ 150 cm², height ~3 cm → 450 ml × 0.5 ≈ 225 g... tempered to ~150 g given sparse pile.
- Sushi rolls (2): ~8% of 314 cm² ≈ 25 cm², height ~2.5 cm → 60 ml × 0.9 ≈ 55 g.
- Spring roll: ~8% ≈ 25 cm², height ~2.5 cm → 60 ml × 0.7 ≈ 45 g.
- Cake slice: ~45% of 254 cm² ≈ 115 cm², height ~3 cm → 345 ml × 0.4 ≈ 120 g (cake is airy, reduced to ~80 g).
- Dressing and soy sauce: ~2 × 10 g ≈ 20 g.

**Step 5–6 - Grams:** Summed above with adjustments: wrap bread ~60 g, wrap filling ~40 g, Greek salad ~150 g, sushi ~55 g, spring roll ~45 g, cake ~80 g, sauces ~20 g. Total ≈ 450 g.

**Step 7 - Energy (per 100 g):**
- Wrap bread (flour tortilla): ~300 kcal
- Wrap filling (mixed greens, vegetables, some dressing): ~60 kcal
- Greek salad with feta and olive oil: ~110 kcal
- Sushi (rice with fish/vegetable): ~150 kcal
- Fresh spring roll (rice paper with vegetables): ~90 kcal
- Frosted cake: ~380 kcal
- Dressing/soy sauce: ~60 kcal

Energy: wrap bread 60 g → 180 kcal; wrap filling 40 g → 24 kcal; salad 150 g → 165 kcal; sushi 55 g → 83 kcal; spring roll 45 g → 41 kcal; cake 80 g → 304 kcal; sauces 20 g → 12 kcal. Total ≈ 809 kcal.

**Step 8 - Sanity check:** About 450 g across five plates and bowls with ~800 kcal is plausible for a full lunch tray with cake.
